text: nice heres another little clean up to hit, this right click context menu is cluttered, a number of these could be contained into a nested menu like mirror controls is one to call out for sure [Image #1]
resolution: Reworked the model viewport right-click menu into compact Select Mode, Gizmo, Mirror, and View families. Mirror now contains both live edit-axis toggles and mirrored-part actions, while View also owns lighting. Paint Faces, contextual topology, duplicate/merge/import, and Quality remain direct. Added layout coverage proving every command appears exactly once and that part actions remain correctly scoped; editor type-check and the ReleaseFast ship both pass.
